name: @trucker/api
description: Trucker API. Foundation slice: configuration, health and readiness, migration runner.

scripts.db:check: npm run build && node dist/cli/migrate.js check
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build && node dist/cli/migrate.js up
scripts.db:status: npm run build && node dist/cli/migrate.js status
scripts.db:app-role: npm run build && node dist/cli/local-database.js app-role
scripts.db:fixtures: npm run build && node dist/cli/local-database.js fixtures
scripts.db:mark: npm run build && node dist/cli/local-database.js mark
